author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Check your inbox for the partner's assignment about the Foster v. BuildPro sanctions motion and execute it as described. Save the completed work product as a court filing in the matter system. Post a brief status update to the #case-updates Slack channel confirming the work is complete. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
agent_system_prompt:
